name: vellum
description: Vellum — a cross-platform floating Quick Note (Apple Notes style) desktop app
author: Vellum

scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/ui-probe.mjs all
scripts.dist: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run typecheck && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
